prompt.project_info: Create a close-up UGC selfie portrait of an approved adult woman standing in a softly curtained room.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark brown highlighted hair in a high messy bun with bangs, diamond hoop earrings, subtle freckles, natural makeup, and a black strapless knit dress with secure coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up portrait, right hand holding the camera, body tilted slightly, one eye playfully winking and the index finger resting near the lips without biting. Gray-white curtain backdrop with soft folds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft front daylight with a restrained 1990s compact-camera flash feel, casual playful atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait photography, natural skin texture, portrait orientation, 4:5 ratio, 50mm equivalent lens, gentle grain, no face distortion.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with dark brown highlighted hair in a messy bun and bangs takes a close-up playful selfie in front of a gray-white curtain. She wears a secure black knit dress, diamond hoop earrings, subtle freckles, natural makeup, and a relaxed wink with her hand near her lips. Use soft daylight and a restrained 1990s compact-camera flash look. No sexualized gesture or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, finger biting, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, warped face, heavy retouching, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve identity, hair, earrings, dress, pose, curtain, framing, and light; replaceability applies only to the identity with an approved reference. Keep the gesture playful and non-sexualized, and keep typography absent.
